description: The only rejection copy is 'Granola rejected this key', for a truncated key, an expired key, a wrong-scope key and a plan without API access alike. Tomas cannot tell what to fix.
expected: A line that names the likely cause or the next step, in the same field.
suggested_fix: Keep one line but add the next step ('Check the key in Granola, Settings, API keys') or branch on 401 vs 403.

description: Network failure, Granola 5xx or 429 while validating a first key have no copy; the only transient state drawn ('Granola is busy. Retrying.') exists only for an already-synced card. A failure at first Connect would read as a rejected key.
expected: A distinct 'could not reach Granola, try again' line for first connect.
actual: Only the connected-card variant is drawn.
suggested_fix: Add a first-connect transient error line.

description: The key field is masked, so after the rejection Tomas cannot see that his paste is cut off, which is the one thing he needs to check. The plan gives no masking rule.
expected: Show enough of the key (last 4 characters) or a reveal toggle to compare against Granola.
suggested_fix: Add a show/hide toggle, or show a masked tail.

description: Not stated when the error line clears: on typing or on the next Connect. The mockup clears it only through the Verifying state.

Rejected state draws the key field as readonly with the old value, so the story's ideal path (replace the key in the same field and press Connect) cannot be shown; Connect in this state submits the same rejected key.
expected: Editable field, cleared or selected for replacement.
suggested_fix: Make the field editable in the rejected state.

description: The sentence 'Rejected state also appears for a key that worked earlier and was revoked in Granola.' is a design note rendered in every card state; it reads as product copy.
expected: Notes visually separated from product UI.
actual: Muted line directly under the card.
suggested_fix: Move to an HTML comment or a boxed 'mockup note'.
